Lemma
[First derivatives of the leading coefficient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0274, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0275 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-volume-density-expansion 1. ch23:23.32\group Asymptotics

\[ | abla _x\phi _0|^2=O(r^2),\qquad \Delta _x\phi _0= rac16R(y)+ rac16( abla _rR)(y)x^r+O(r^2). \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the normal-coordinate expansion for $\alpha ^{1/2}$ and use $\Delta f=\alpha ^{-1}\partial _i(\alpha g^{ij}\partial _jf)$, together with the contracted Bianchi identity.

□
